0022600006.text: The 76ers are 1-0 and first in the Atlantic Division, second in the East, with a road win and a W1 streak. The Cavaliers have not played a 2026-27 game yet, and Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (out, ruptured Achilles), Dominick Barlow (out, back), and Tacko Fall (out, hip), while Dean Wade is day-to-day with an ankle sprain. Cleveland is missing Nae'Qwan Tomlin (out, back), and Khalifa Diop (knee) and Sam Merrill (elbow soreness) are both day-to-day. The teams last met on March 9, 2026, in Cleveland, where the 76ers lost 115-101, and the 76ers lost 0-4 to the Cavaliers in 2025-26, with no games yet in the 2026-27 season series.
